# Phase 1 results

The canonical substrate is v783 with bare `lif.g_inh = 1`, `background: false`, dopamine layer A and transporter layer C on, and fast DAN synapses retained. The K2/Q dopamine record is frozen and qualified; K1 is skipped under SPEC item 47. The bare switch preserves the sugar reflex at 86 Hz upstream and 53 Hz extended on v783, but gives up a calibrated spontaneous resting state. The ratio-4 development drive had suppressed that reflex to 0/0 Hz with background off and 3/8 Hz with background on, while its apparent resting activity missed K1 targets and did not qualify. No frozen drive record was made. On the bare substrate, the provisional tonic dopamine source maintains 0.02 µM in innervated compartments without DAN firing, and `alpha_max = 0.1 µM` per weighted spike is a placeholder phasic scale, not a fitted biological measurement, because K2 measured `R_c = 0` in all 37 compartments (SPEC item 56). The encoder cap `vis.r_max = 300 Hz` is a placeholder like the K1 targets (item 59). K1 population rate targets are placeholders. These limits narrow the interpretation of all drug and behavioural results.

The final sign check ran on seeds 1–3 at 100, 140 and 280 Hz visual drive, 11 azimuth dwells per rate. Every dwell had 0 Hz steering left–right difference and 0 deg/s turn rate. The 300 Hz encoder cap was not exceeded. K3 therefore had no closed-loop candidate, selected no empirical fit, and froze the section 9.1 fallback: `K_steer = 4`, `r_vis_max = 280 Hz`, `sigma_vis = 20 deg`, `sign_steer = +1`, `qualified: false`. A near-one fixation index in subsequent Buridan trajectories can follow from the initial heading with no responsive steering and is not a behavioural validation.

The runner's final level-4 classification is 4.1 **failed**, measured on the matching bare layers; 4.2 and 4.4–4.8 **unavailable** with reason `sign curve flat at 280 Hz, section 9.1 fallback`. The Brembs 4.3 holdout is **unavailable and sealed**: split SHA-256 `883c48d78b8404145a3831c9365bfbc3865a6d66b60c02ec6c7f4c944ee0be63`; the holdout file was not executed and no comparison was made. Fixation predictions for wild type, fumin and Dop1R1-null in vehicle and methylphenidate arms are unavailable for the same reason. The open-loop and acceptance runs below are integration measurements without a behavioural claim.

### History: bbb00c2 pair (review r11)

Review r11 evaluated the partial-delivery predicate at `bbb00c22034f6bf392f6f6096d491812e4f1a6e7` on MCP I4 runs `20260914T172729.979889Z-0d0a9a8c` and `20260914T193256.822683Z-0d0a9a8c`. Clauses 2, 4, 5 and 6 held. Clause 3 failed because test 0.8 was development-class: its fixture had only sugar-reflex probes, so every execution named the `IdentityBehaviour` stub (item 70). Clause 1 failed in real wall time: the manifest walls 5844.634 and 4700.647 s are `time.monotonic`, which stops while macOS sleeps; real elapsed was 7524.774 and 4703.448 s, run 1 spanned about 1775 s of machine sleep, and run 1 and the pair (12228.222 s) exceeded the 5965.871 and 11931.741 s budgets (item 71). Review r11 also found that bare 1.4 and 2.2 existed only inside the qualified Q record, now the canonical entries `1.4-bare` and `2.2-bare` (item 74), and asked for rulings on development entries omitted from manifests (item 72) and level-3 re-analysis at a later commit (item 73). All 38 non-development entries of that status bound `valid`. That pair is not edited. Item 70's pair at 119d533 supersedes it.
